metadata.description: Close-up woven carbon fiber texture with geometric basketweave pattern
metadata.visual_content: Black-and-white macro shot of woven rigid fibers in basketweave pattern (over-under). Thick flat rectangular strands interlaced creating grid of raised 3D blocks. High-contrast lighting with bright highlights on top edges, deep shadows in recesses. Shallow depth of field with sharp foreground and blurred background
metadata.context: Background texture for 'Impacto' theme, suggests modern technical sophistication, high-strength materials, premium industrial aesthetic
